prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a NEW full-body transparent visual-novel sprite of Furina.
Reference policy: Image 1 is the unaltered official transparent portrait, the PRIMARY identity, costume and colour authority. Image 2 is the exact USER-APPROVED neutral, for body proportions, face identity, relative head size, rendering and portrait scale. Create the entire illustration afresh from these two fixed references. No defective expression is provided or used.
Character acting and pose: Give Furina warm affectionate eyes and a sincere smile for a dear friend. Put one gloved hand over her chest and let the other rest open beside her waist. Use an uncomplicated stance with exactly two anatomically connected legs from one pelvis and exactly two visible feet on the same standing baseline, separated with only a slight stagger. Do not cross the legs or draw an extra knee, thigh, shin or shoe. Keep coat tails clearly distinct from her two legs.
Hand construction: coherent anatomically left/right palms and wrists, each with one thumb on its correct side and four fingers. Prefer simple readable gestures nearly in the image plane; avoid camera-reaching hands, extreme foreshortening, tangled fingers or ambiguous curls. Limb construction: one pelvis, exactly two arms, two legs and two feet; keep the stance uncomplicated and accessories distinct from limbs. Face construction: one coherent mouth with a readable natural lip shape.
Eyes: Both eyes visibly open. Keep each original multicoloured blue iris and all its colour/detail. Replace only each small central pupil with a clear filled WHITE heart, plainly visible inside the iris. These hearts are actual pupils, not catchlights or whole-iris replacements. Retain separate tiny natural catchlights.
Preserve the character's official hair, skin tone, outfit, accessories and approved underlying anatomy, while using the requested new emotional body language. Complete centered figure with all headwear, ears, hair, hands, coat tails, accessories and shoes in frame. Aim for 92–96% canvas height with roughly 2–4% transparent top and bottom padding, without stretching. Polished anime rendering matching the approved neutral. TRUE TRANSPARENT background; no scenery, UI, labels, text, floating effects, weapon, watermark or ground shadow.
